value.behaviour: Provide pure functions for normalising, applying, shifting, comparing, and mapping `TextStyleRange` entries onto wrapped text lines and visual runs.
rules: 1. Export `type TextStyleRun = { readonly text: string; readonly start: number; readonly end: number; readonly strokeColor?: string; readonly backgroundColor?: string }` and re-export `type { TextStyleRange }` from `./types`.

2. `normalizeTextStyleRanges(ranges, textLength, elementStrokeColor?)`: return `[]` if `!Array.isArray(ranges) || ranges.length === 0 || !Number.isFinite(textLength) || textLength <= 0`; clamp integer `start` and `end` to `[0, Math.floor(textLength)]`; drop entries with `start >= end`; treat `strokeColor` as undefined if empty, `"transparent"`, or equal to `elementStrokeColor`; treat `backgroundColor` as undefined if empty or `"transparent"`; resolve overlaps using sorted elementary intervals `[points[i], points[i + 1])` where later input ranges override earlier ranges per property (`strokeColor` and `backgroundColor` independently while preserving non-overridden properties); sort by ascending `start` and merge adjacent intervals (`prev.end === next.start`) when both `strokeColor` and `backgroundColor` match.

3. `applyTextStyleRange(ranges, textLength, selection, style, elementStrokeColor?)`: normalise `ranges` first; if `!selection || !Number.isFinite(selection.start) || !Number.isFinite(selection.end)` or clamped `selStart >= selEnd`, return normalised ranges; otherwise decompose over elementary intervals including `selStart` and `selEnd`, applying `style.strokeColor` (clearing when empty, `"transparent"`, or equal to `elementStrokeColor`) and/or `style.backgroundColor` (clearing when empty or `"transparent"`) across `[selStart, selEnd)` while preserving orthogonal properties on overlapping sub-intervals, omitting intervals with neither property left, and merging adjacent identical intervals.

4. `shiftTextStyleRangesOnEdit(ranges, prevText, nextText)`: normalise `ranges` against `prevText.length`; if `prevText === nextText` return normalised ranges; if `normalized.length === 0 || nextText.length === 0` return `[]`; compute minimal edit splice via common prefix `changeStart` and common suffix (`changeEnd` in `prevText`, `insertedLength`, `delta = insertedLength - (changeEnd - changeStart)`); keep ranges with `end <= changeStart` unchanged, shift ranges with `start >= changeEnd` by `delta`, drop ranges with `changeEnd > changeStart && start >= changeStart && end <= changeEnd`, and for partially overlapping/spanning ranges set `newStart = start < changeStart ? start : start === changeStart && end > changeEnd && insertedLength > 0 ? changeStart : changeStart + insertedLength` and `newEnd = end > changeEnd ? end + delta : changeStart`, then pass through `normalizeTextStyleRanges(..., nextText.length)`.

5. `getWrappedLineTextRuns(line, ranges)`: slice `WrappedTextLine` (`{ text, start, end }`) into contiguous `TextStyleRun[]` covering `[line.start, line.end)` using `line.text.slice(runStart - line.start, runEnd - line.start)`; return a single unstyled run `[{ text: line.text, start: line.start, end: line.end }]` when `line.end <= line.start` or no ranges intersect `[line.start, line.end)`.

6. `getWrappedTextLinesForElement(element, maxWidth?, env?)` and `getTextElementLineRuns(element, env?, maxWidth?)`: use `getWrappedTextLines` from `./textWrapping` with `getFontString(element)` (when `maxWidth` is omitted, use `Infinity` if `normalizedText === normalizedOriginalText`, else try `getWrappedTextLines(normalizedOriginalText, font, element.width, env)` and if its line texts differ from `element.text.replace(/
?/g, "
").split("
")`, align the split visual lines sequentially against `normalizedOriginalText` skipping soft-wrap whitespace or `
` between lines), then map each `WrappedTextLine` with `getWrappedLineTextRuns`.

7. `getSelectionTextStyle(element, selection)`: slice `[selection.start, selection.end)` with `getWrappedLineTextRuns` against normalised ranges and return `{ strokeColor: string | null; backgroundColor: string | null }` where `strokeColor` is the common `run.strokeColor ?? element.strokeColor` across all runs in the selection (`null` if mixed) and `backgroundColor` is the common `run.backgroundColor ?? "transparent"` across all runs in the selection (`null` if mixed).
8. `areTextStyleRangesEqual(a, b)`: return `true` when both range lists normalise/have equal length and identical `start`, `end`, `strokeColor`, and `backgroundColor` at every index.

value.behaviour: Render styled text runs and inline background highlight rectangles on Canvas 2D when `element.textStyleRanges` is non-empty.
rules: 1. Import `getLineWidth` alongside `getLineHeightInPx` from `./textMeasurements`, and import `getTextElementLineRuns` from `./textStyleRanges`.

2. In `drawElementOnCanvas` for `isTextElement(element)`, if `!element.textStyleRanges?.length`, execute the existing single `context.fillText(lines[index], horizontalOffset, index * lineHeightPx + verticalOffset)` loop unchanged (NFR-3).
3. If `element.textStyleRanges?.length` is non-zero, compute `const font = getFontString(element);` and `const lineRuns = getTextElementLineRuns(element, renderConfig.renderEnvironment);`.

4. For each visual line `index`, compute `lineText = lines[index] ?? ""`, `lineWidth = getLineWidth(lineText, font, renderConfig.renderEnvironment)`, and `lineStartX = element.textAlign === "center" ? (element.width - lineWidth) / 2 : element.textAlign === "right" ? element.width - lineWidth : 0`.

5. In Pass 1 (background highlights), for each run in `lineRuns[index]` with a non-empty, non-`"transparent"` `backgroundColor` and `run.text.length > 0`, compute `prefixWidth = getLineWidth(prefixText, font, renderConfig.renderEnvironment)` and `runWidth = getLineWidth(run.text, font, renderConfig.renderEnvironment)`, `runX = rtl ? lineStartX + (lineWidth - prefixWidth - runWidth) : lineStartX + prefixWidth`, set `context.fillStyle = applyDarkModeFilter(run.backgroundColor, renderConfig.theme === THEME.DARK)`, and call `context.fillRect(runX, index * lineHeightPx, runWidth, lineHeightPx)`.

6. In Pass 2 (glyph ink), set `context.textAlign = rtl ? "right" : "left"`, and for each run in `lineRuns[index]` with `run.text.length > 0`, set `context.fillStyle = applyDarkModeFilter(run.strokeColor ?? element.strokeColor, renderConfig.theme === THEME.DARK)` and call `context.fillText(run.text, rtl ? runX + runWidth : runX, index * lineHeightPx + verticalOffset)`.

sites.rule: Keep the existing `context.fillText` loop when `!element.textStyleRanges?.length`; when `element.textStyleRanges?.length` is non-zero, compute line runs with `getTextElementLineRuns`, draw Pass 1 background highlight `context.fillRect`s, and draw Pass 2 glyph `context.fillText`s per run with `applyDarkModeFilter`.
